# key-remap

> A tiny free Windows utility that swaps the roles of the ` key and Alt+` on a US (English) keyboard layout, for Japanese IME users.

## What it does

- Pressing ` alone toggles Japanese IME on/off (it acts as the Hankaku/Zenkaku key, which US keyboards do not have).
- Pressing Alt+` types the backquote character ` itself.
- Shift+` still types ~ (tilde). Ctrl+` and other combinations are untouched.

## Facts

- Platform: Windows 10 / 11
- Works with: Microsoft IME, Google Japanese Input
- Price: free, open source (MIT License)
- Size: 104 KB single executable; resident memory usage about 1 MB
- Installation: none. Run key-remap.exe; no registry changes. Uninstall by ending the process and deleting the file.
- Implementation: dependency-free Rust using a low-level keyboard hook (WH_KEYBOARD_LL) and SendInput.
